features.summary: These changes improve media timing and reliability: audio time-stretching now keeps the playback clock aligned with the original audio, and time values avoid conversions that could lose precision. They also add safer handling for preference callbacks and decoder errors, while keeping Matroska playback metrics available through version 168.

features.summary: The Gecko Media Plugins (GMP) service, which supports media components such as DRM, can now start without waiting for the main thread. The changes also make setup failures, shutdown races, and access to stored data safer and more predictable.

features.summary: These updates make media decoder state safer to use and improve Linux support for Vulkan Video, a technology for hardware-accelerated video decoding. They also account for differences in NVIDIA DRM capabilities and older FFmpeg versions on AMD systems, avoiding unsupported direct video export.

features.label: WebCodecs

patches.author: Chun-Min Chang

features.summary: WebCodecs now handles integer PCM audio using the correct sample format, and applies the “discard” alpha setting only when creating an opaque VideoFrame. The changes also improve cleanup when decoder setup fails and add a crash test to help catch regressions.

features.label: HTMLMediaElement

patches.author: Emilio Cobos Álvarez
patches.subject: Always handle video visibility notifications async.

patches.author: Kagami Sascha Rosylight
patches.subject: Return nsISupports* from MediaError::GetParentObject

features.summary: Video visibility updates from HTML media elements are now handled asynchronously, helping keep changes in page visibility from disrupting media processing. A related adjustment improves how media errors connect to their parent objects _without changing what users see_.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Add a mochitest for media elements sharing a resource.

patches.author: Randell Jesup
patches.subject: Enforce module script MIME type checks for worklets.

features.summary: New tests check that multiple media elements can share a resource and that worklet module scripts use the required JavaScript MIME type. This helps catch problems with shared media and ensures worklets follow the browser’s script-loading rules.

features.label: Tests (gtest)

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Add gtests for GMP service creation racing the main thread and shutdown.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Part 3: Test that rate changes keep the audio clock on the source position.

features.summary: New tests cover races when the Gecko Media Plugins (GMP) service starts or shuts down alongside the main thread. They also check that changing audio playback speed keeps the audio clock tied to the source position, helping playback timing stay consistent.

features.label: WebVTT / captions

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Part 2: Test the auto cue position for start and end alignment.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Part 1: Use 50 as the auto cue position for start and end alignment.

features.summary: WebVTT captions now use position 50 for automatically placed cues aligned to the start or end of the video. This gives those captions a consistent placement, with tests covering both alignment cases.

features.label: Docs

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Part 4: Document how the audio clock counts the time stretcher output.

features.summary: The documentation now explains how the audio clock accounts for output from the time stretcher, which adjusts audio to match playback-speed changes. This clarifies how the clock stays related to the original audio position.

features.label: Encrypted Media (EME / DRM)

patches.author: Andrew Osmond
patches.subject: Bound the provisioning retries in MediaDrmRemoteCDMParent.

features.summary: Provisioning retries for MediaDrm, the Android system used for digital rights management (DRM), are now limited. This prevents repeated attempts from continuing indefinitely when a device or service cannot complete setup.

features.label: HLS

patches.author: John Lin
patches.subject: extend HLS metrics expiry to version 168.

features.summary: HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) playback metrics will remain available through Firefox version 168. This extends the lifetime of the data used to understand how HLS streams are playing.

features.label: Media IPC

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Match the media engine of a remote decoder with its manager.

features.summary: Remote media decoders are now matched with the correct media engine manager over Media IPC, Firefox’s communication channel between media processes. This helps ensure decoder requests are handled by the component that manages them.

features.label: Media diagnostics (doctor)

patches.author: Osmond Arnesto
patches.subject: Replace button.footer with moz-button in toolkit/content/widgets/

features.summary: The media diagnostics panel now uses Firefox’s standard button component instead of its older custom footer button. This brings its button in line with the browser’s shared interface; no larger change to media diagnostics is indicated.

features.summary: Web Speech’s content-permission requests were reorganized into separate shared and parent-process-only foundations. This is an internal cleanup of how speech features request permission, with no user-facing behavior change indicated by the patch title.
